independent_control: Same width, dense certificate input history and W/b; R diagonal (6+3i)/20, independently differentiated diagonal only. Archived width-scaling Model recipe; no outcome selection.
horizons: Archived dense horizons 11,22,37. Matched independent uses same horizons. Prefixes 4 and 8 are float64 diagnostics, not rank certificates.
second_precision_case: dense n=4 fixed-h raw sensitivity Jacobian
primary_coordinates: Raw parameter coordinates; Euclidean total input-history perturbation norm; Frobenius sensitivity norm; tanh hidden coordinates unchanged.
secondary_coordinates: Input standard deviation sqrt(3/32); relative parameter perturbations using one RMS scale per R/W/b block, fixed at base parameters. Report alongside raw results; no inverse-Jacobian normalization.
fixed_h_derivative: A=J_S N where N is an orthonormal basis of ker J_h. This is a local tangent diagnostic, not a finite-radius certificate.
query_family_primary: All current-state adjoints with Euclidean norm <=1; absolute gradient error in the matching parameter coordinates.
query_family_secondary: Fixed q=ones/sqrt(n), one future step, preactivations in [1/4,3/4]^n; loss divided by beta=max(1,Frobenius norm R), constant in theta. May require inputs outside archived past-input support.
reachable_patch: Use archived outward Jacobian intervals and inverse preconditioner with a global tanh derivative/Hessian bound on an input infinity cube of radius <=1; derive conservative explicit contraction radius. Do not present this radius as the largest reachable patch.
epsilon_policy: No chosen practical epsilon. Publish threshold curves and conditional epsilon/radius formulas; thresholds are diagnostics, not promotion gates.
stop: Stop after proof, archived-witness spectra and matched independent controls. No architecture, learning, Stage C or AMS v10.
classification_rule: No fixed-error arbitrary-width conclusion without width-uniform patch/query conditioning. Numerical collapse at archived witnesses does not refute existence of better-conditioned histories. Use FINITE-PRECISION QUESTION REMAINS OPEN if quantitative behavior is not settled; use ROBUST DIMENSION DEPENDS STRONGLY ON SCALE/HORIZON if rigorous scale dependence and these controlled diagnostics support it.
